newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.47 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.47 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.871 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 26.902, and at 17.847 to the mark from 17.856.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.47 percent compared with a deviation of +2.40 on Thursday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +2.44.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
